answer: Only one live horn may speak from a marked canyon ledge in the same watch. After escrowing 44 units, reserve ledge L=H(pubkey||rim||watch) mod the trail board. At minute (hash mod 17)+6 recite a 14-line sonnet into horn H so the first echo from orchard terrace T, 2.3 km downslope, lands in that hash's 19 ms bin. Two rim peers replay the spectrogram and void any ledge already on a live watch or a mid-recital refund. A pitch miss over 18 cents, an off-bin echo, or a reused rim-id burns 16 units and benches the key 12 epochs; a cloned spectrogram or second fault empties the stake for 17 epochs.
